Indexed Central Files: The Department of State used the decimal central file system through January 1963 after which it began a new subject-numeric central filing system. The new subject-numeric system was divided into broad categories: Administration, Consular, Culture and Information, Economic, Political and Defense, Science, and Social. Within these categories were subcategories and then numerical subdivisions relating to specific topics. The subject-numeric system used an abbreviation rather than a number for a country, area, or topic. The decimal and subject-numeric central files were major sources for this volume.
